compatibility_targets.interpretation: Descriptive already inspected July/September historical and December development references; development goal never enters selection.

policies.fit: same deadline_wait0 train identities and approval/order-ID sorted daily queries as frozen backlog101 topk10; train-only preprocessing
policies.historical_scores: each historical month uses its own monthly model; never final-model rescores of training rows
policies.ranking: uncalibrated score descending then order_id ascending; threshold zero, fill daily floor(10% * complete eligible scored batch)
policies.label_maturity: historical validation outcomes strictly before E; unknown labels still compete for full-batch slots
policies.selection: maximize worst recall of three known-label historical months, then pooled TP, pooled raw AP, fixed candidate order
policies.floor: 30% each historical month is a diagnostic suitability gate; no future recall guarantee
policies.search: Only topk versus mean at numeric parameter10 / L2=100; no fixed-k expansion, extra candidate, eval set or early stopping
policies.comparison: Only lambdarank_pair_method changes in configured wrapper/native parameters. Mean changes internal pair sampling and normalization semantics; not equal generated pair count or equal compute and not a dynamic10% target
policies.features: exact frozen backlog101 columns; no new features or recalculation
policies.probabilities: strictly monotone sigmoid(raw margin) bounded interface only, not calibrated probability; distinct-margin collapse refused
policies.evaluation_role: all E months and design have been informed by repeatedly inspected development results; pre-fit specification does not make these periods independent tests
policies.coverage: eligible valid eventually-delivered cohort only; not every originally approved order
policies.batch_timing: complete closed calendar-day batches required; up to one day wait; no per-order online cap guarantee
policies.promotion: new artifacts remain research only; original and prior research models preserved
policies.visualization: no dashboard or new plots in this experiment; user requested ranking work first
policies.pending_limit: no cancellation timestamp available; approved cancelled orders can remain pending inside the 30/90-day windows; static master-table location assumption
policies.ranker: rank:ndcg; numerical pair parameter10; topk means top10 positions, mean means sampled pairs per row; ndcg@20 unchanged with no eval set/early stopping
policies.training_clock: delivery clock is actual delivery; deadline clock is min(actual delivery, midnight after promised calendar date); original actual-delivery metadata and history unchanged
policies.clock_limit: eventual-delivery cohort remains retrospectively selected; no cancellation outcome labels inferred; assumes original promise date and immediate delivery event availability
policies.paired_comparison: same backlog101 features, train rows/order/day groups/preprocessor and numerical parameter10; topk versus mean only
policies.geolocation: seventh file treated as static postal reference available at approval; paired-valid-coordinate per-ZIP median, great-circle distance not road distance; no as-of version metadata or result-based coordinate clipping
policies.dispatch_availability: no dispatch candidates reused or fitted in this round; frozen preceding sensitivity report retained
policies.primary_selection: frozen75 plus new1; maximize worst historical recall then pooledTP/AP/fixed order;30% suitability only; descriptive compatibility never overrides selection
policies.solver: Logistic retains L2/lbfgs C1 or C.01/max_iter10000; reject ConvergenceWarning or n_iter >= max_iter; solver diagnostics never select models
policies.training_queries: contiguous approval days among eligible mature training rows; retain all-positive/all-negative groups, which supply no unlike-label pairs
policies.previous_reuse: 8 saved backlog101 topk10 versions replayed; all75 old metric records copied value-for-value from SHA-bound source; other592 old monthly versions not rescored

split.training_source_cutoff: Training approvals are strictly before model_fit_time minus 60 days; training delivery labels are strictly before model_fit_time. Each fitted model and preprocessing pipeline use only this training partition.
split.scoring_source_cutoff: Scoring cohort uses only approval timestamps within the supplied valid-delivered cohort; it is not filtered by label availability. Prior event features must still use only completed events strictly before each individual approval.
split.maturity_scope: Maturity exclusions are within the existing valid delivered cohort only; cancelled, unfinished and other excluded orders do not receive inferred negative labels.

training_split.training_source_cutoff: Training approvals are strictly before model fit minus the configured wait; the selected training outcome clock must be strictly before model fit. Actual delivery timestamps are never rewritten.
training_split.scoring_source_cutoff: Scoring cohort uses only approval timestamps within the supplied valid-delivered cohort; it is not filtered by label availability. Prior event features must still use only completed events strictly before each individual approval.
training_split.maturity_scope: Maturity exclusions are within the existing valid delivered cohort only; cancelled, unfinished and other excluded orders do not receive inferred negative labels.
training_split.training_outcome_clock_formula: min(actual delivery timestamp, estimated delivery calendar date + 1 day at midnight)
training_split.validation_maturity_clock_unchanged: label_available_time (actual delivery), strictly before selection time
training_split.clock_limitations: Unchanged eventually-delivered eligible cohort; does not establish eventual delivery for raw pending orders. No event-ingestion timestamps or promise-revision history; assumes delivery records and original promise are timely available.
